We acknowledge receipt of your dispute letter regarding the account listed above. We understand that you have disputed the debt as inaccurate and requested its removal from your credit report.

The account was charged off on August 22, 2020, and the last payment received was on March 22, 2021.

We will conduct a thorough investigation into this matter and will provide a response to your dispute within the timeframes required by law. If our investigation confirms that the debt is indeed yours, we will work with you to resolve the matter. However, if our investigation confirms that the debt is not yours, we will take steps to remove the account from your credit report.

You have the right to dispute this debt further, and we encourage you to provide any additional information that may be relevant to our investigation. Please note that under Kentucky state law, we are required to provide you with a written validation notice if you dispute the debt.

We appreciate your prompt attention to this matter, and we will keep you informed of any developments.
